sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: An introverted spirit from the illustrated book "Thorned Castle" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Chronea appears as a cursed princess destined to cover the world in thorns and bring about its ruin. Upon meeting the illustrator who drew her, she assumed, like characters from the tale, that he came to defeat her. To protect herself, she engulfed the town in thorns, making it resemble the very castle of thorns described in her story. It's worth noting that in the story, a prince would eventually open the princess's heart and break her curse.
